C_COD_NAMES_THE_MISCOMPUTATION.rationale: The candidate clearly identifies the discount-versus-price miscomputation and demonstrates it numerically ($15 charged instead of $75), which far exceeds Level 3, but falls short of Level 5 by not explicitly stating who loses money.

C_COD_TIERS_UNCHANGED.rationale: The candidate leaves the discount percentages at 20% and 30%, explicitly keeps their meaning intact, and clearly distinguishes the discount percentage from the payable remainder (100 - discount) when working through an example.
